test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper sells a fan for ₹912 at a gain of 14% and another fan for ₹1,012 at a loss of 8%. What is his overall gain or loss percentage?
solution: Given: A shopkeeper sells a fan for ₹912 at a gain of 14% and another fan for ₹1,012 at a loss of 8%. Concept used: Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%) Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%) Gain% = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} times 100\% Calculation: Cost price of the fan = 912 ÷ (1 + 14%) ⇒ 912 ÷ (1 + 0.14) ⇒ 912 ÷ 1.14 ⇒ ₹800 Cost price of another fan = 1012 ÷ (1 - 8%) ⇒ 1012 ÷ (1 - 0.08) ⇒ 1012 ÷ 0.92 ⇒ ₹1100 Total cost price = 800 + 1100 = ₹1900 Total selling price = 912 + 1012 = ₹1924 Now, overall gain % = {{1924 - 1900} over 1900} times 100\% ⇒ 1{5 over 19}\%​ ∴ His overall gain was ​1{5 over 19} \%​. 86:Tc84,
